name: LobbyStack
description: Self-hostable AI phone receptionist that answers calls, books appointments, transfers callers and handles text messages.
whatItDoes: Picks up inbound calls for a small business, answers common questions, schedules appointments on a calendar and hands off to a person when needed. Staff get a dashboard with call history and an SMS inbox.
howItWorks: Calls arrive through a Twilio SIP trunk and are handled by a realtime OpenAI voice model with tools for calendar booking and call transfer. A TypeScript application backed by PostgreSQL and Redis provides the dashboard and webhooks. Business knowledge can be gathered from the company website.

requirements.name: Docker and pnpm
requirements.description: Used to install and start the stack

requirements.name: Twilio account
requirements.description: Phone numbers and SIP trunk, including TWILIO_SIP_TRUNK_SID

requirements.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
requirements.description: Google OAuth credentials for calendar booking, with GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET

requirements.name: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY
requirements.description: Website crawling for the knowledge base
